t: Can People Buy Plots Of Land On The Moon?

I’m not a nation, so why can’t I buy 40 acres on the Moon with a nice view of the Apollo 15 landing site?” Contrary to what you might believe, this provision absolutely prevents you from buying that gray, arid hunk of moon that you crave.
